**Finding: deviation (critical) — LOL-CAP**

The agreement has no standalone limitation-of-liability section; the only cap sits at the end of Section 12 (Indemnity), at paragraph p0077, and it is one-sided:

- **One-way cap.** It limits only TrueLink's liability. Client (Mortgage Logic.com) is entirely uncapped, including under the very broad Section 12a indemnity — our walk-away position.
- **Weak basis.** "Total compensation **paid** for Hosting and Support Services" excludes amounts payable but unpaid and the "other services" fees contemplated by Section 5a, and there is no USD floor.
- **No mutual damages exclusion / carve-outs.** Only TrueLink's gross negligence and wilful misconduct are excepted; confidentiality (Section 10), indemnification, fraud and IP infringement are not carved out, and there is no mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages.

**Redline (validated, preferred level):** replaced the single sentence in p0077 with a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, a mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and an "Excluded Claims" set (confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification under Section 12, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) sitting outside the cap, with Client's fee payment obligations expressly not capped damages. Fallback offered in the comment: straight twelve months' fees with the carve-outs retained.
